title: Bryan Johnson's haircare protocol: nutrition, peptides, laser cap and minoxidil
summary: Bryan lays out the five-part routine he credits for having better hair at 49 than 29, with about 70% of his gray gone. It covers nutrition, Blueprint peptide shampoo and serum, a daily laser cap, oral minoxidil and topical minoxidil, plus advice to start before thinning is visible.

principles.text: Good hair starts with whole-food nutrition: enough protein, omega-3 and key vitamins and minerals.
principles.quote: Your body needs good food to make good hair.

principles.text: Avoid processed junk and added sugar; hair needs iron, selenium, biotin, zinc, and vitamins C, D, E.
principles.quote: In general, eat whole foods and avoid processed junk and added sugar.

principles.text: Scalp routine: peptide shampoo left on for 2 min, then peptide serum massaged in with a silicone scrubber for blood flow.
principles.quote: I apply [Peptide Hair Serum](https://blueprint.bryanjohnson.com/products/hair-peptide-serum) and massage it into my scalp with a silicone scrubber for 1–2 min to stimulate blood flow.

principles.text: Wear a low-level laser cap for 6 minutes a day to support regrowth.
principles.quote: I wear the [302 Laser Cap](https://blueprint.bryanjohnson.com/products/laser-cap) for 6 min a day.

principles.text: Oral minoxidil titrated up from 2.5 mg to 3.75 mg while watching for side effects, plus 1 mL of 5% topical nightly.
principles.quote: I started with 2.5 mg and evaluated for side effects. I now take 3.75 mg a day.

principles.text: Start a hair protocol before thinning is visible, since much loss occurs before it is noticed.
principles.quote: Start before you can see thinning.
